prompt: Locked off: the camera holds perfectly still on this high wide view, one single continuous shot. The four heavy tracked robots finish turning on the spot, their tracks churning in opposite directions, then grind away down the slope toward the bottom left of the frame, away from the green doors, slowly at first and gathering speed. Their hulls pitch and rock over the uneven turf; white chalk and torn turf spray from the tracks and dust drifts behind them. The green doors stay shut and small at the top right. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, heavy 16mm grain.
